'''Abasi Vesco''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] who worked for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], he was stationed on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] when he alerted a Republic [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] of a droid virus that was causing droids to go berserk and attack organics. Fearing that the virus would spread and infect every intelligent machine on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], he tasked the spacer to help him stop the virus.
